data.holdout: 2025-07-01 onward — not loaded or inspected until the verdict is written
data.source: binance public klines via data.binance.vision, see data/manifest/

decision_rule.note: Reject the null when |z| >= 2 against shuffled data. Fixed before any result was computed. Not adjustable. A positive z confirms the SW-0002 direction; a negative z would mean continuation ALSO loses, which would point at a measurement artefact rather than a market property.

derived.note: Detection limit for the population test: the smallest TRUE mean market-neutral gross Sharpe, across the whole search space, that this design could distinguish from shuffled data with 80% power. Says nothing about any individual variant.

hypothesis: Following on from the exploratory finding in SW-0002, that short-horizon mean reversion carries systematically negative market-neutral gross Sharpe: the mirrored continuation rules, using identical indicators, lookbacks, thresholds and exit rules, will show a POSITIVE mean market-neutral gross Sharpe across the search space, distinguishable from shuffled data. This is a confirmatory test of a direction discovered post hoc in SW-0002 and registered before being run.

planning.sd_source: measured null calibration from SW-0002 (10 shuffled runs, sd 0.0620)

protocol.execution_model: signal from bar t close, held over bar t+1, no partial fills, position capped at 1x notional per side
protocol.method: Fixed rules, no in-sample parameter fitting. Every variant evaluated over the full period. Market exposure removed per variant by regressing gross returns on the underlying bar returns; the residual Sharpe is the quantity of interest.
protocol.survivorship_note: symbols fixed at the start of the period, no delisting selection

search_space.enumeration_note: 3 families x 6 lookbacks x 5 thresholds x 3 exits x 3 caps x 2 symbols = 1620 fully enumerated variants. Deliberately the exact mirror of SW-0002 so that direction is the only thing that differs.

family_descriptions.bollinger_breakout: intrabar break of Bollinger band, follow
family_descriptions.zscore_continuation: z-score of close vs rolling mean, follow extremes

title: Short-horizon continuation on BTC and ETH spot, hourly
